questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . Nithya Menen’s Best Actress award is also an unconventional choice — as the effervesce (A)/ Shobhana in Thiruchitrambalam, hers is not a typical award-bait role. (B)/ Yet, within the film’s scheme, it was a stunning performance (C)/ which raised its overall effect by several notches. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Nithya Menen’s Best Actress award is also an unconventional choice — as the effervesce (A)/ Shobhana in Thiruchitrambalam, hers is not a typical award-bait role. (B)/ Yet, within the film’s scheme, it was a stunning performance (C)/ which raised its overall effect by several notches. (D)
questions.solution: 'effervescent' will be used instead of 'effervesce' because an adjective is needed here to describe 'Shobhana' (a character). 'Effervesce' is a verb, while 'effervescent' is an adjective that denotes liveliness. The correct sentence will be: As the effervescent Shobhana in Thiruchitrambalam.

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence . After a long, desparate search for peace, she found that a simple walk in nature could both exhilarate her spirit and turn leisure into a moment where she could perceive the beauty around her more clearly.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

After a long, desparate search for peace, she found that a simple walk in nature could both exhilarate her spirit and turn leisure into a moment where she could perceive the beauty around her more clearly.
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘Desparate’ is ‘Desperate,’ which means “feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad as to be impossible to deal with” निराशाजनक, हताश.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks . The investigators had to delve into the __________ web to _________ down the elusive cybercriminal.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks.

The investigators had to delve into the __________ web to _________ down the elusive cybercriminal.
questions.solution: 'Dark' and 'track' will be used because "dark web" refers to a place where illegal and hidden activities occur, and "track down" means to search and find someone. The sentence talks about investigators delving into this complex and hidden world to catch the elusive cybercriminal, making 'dark' and 'track' appropriate here. Whereas, 'Catch' means to capture, 'Crack' means to break or solve, and 'Come' means to arrive, which do not fit in this context.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homonyms from the given alternatives to fill in the blanks I couldn’t tell ____________we would be able to __________ the storm before it hit. Alternatives: A. whether B. weather C. weather (of related to climate)
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate homonyms from the given alternatives to fill in the blanks
I couldn’t tell ____________we would be able to __________ the storm before it hit.
Alternatives:

A. whether

B. weather

C. weather (of related to climate)
questions.solution: 'Whether' and 'weather' will be used because "whether" indicates uncertainty or choice, and "weather" refers to dealing with a situation, not just climate. In this sentence, the context involves enduring a situation (the storm), so 'weather' (dealing with a situation) is correct, not 'weather' (related to climate). The sentence discusses the speaker's uncertainty about whether they could endure the storm before it hit, making 'whether' and 'weather' the correct choices. Other options do not fit in this context.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . PUNJAB’s drug problem is so severe that every effort aimed at stemming the rot deserves praise. (A)/ It is commendable that many Punjabi celebrities — from renowned (B)/ actors and singers to outstanding sportspersons — (C)/ have exhorted people of the state for shunning drugs and restore the health of Punjabi youth. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

PUNJAB’s drug problem is so severe that every effort aimed at stemming the rot deserves praise. (A)/ It is commendable that many Punjabi celebrities — from renowned (B)/ actors and singers to outstanding sportspersons — (C)/ have exhorted people of the state for shunning drugs and restore the health of Punjabi youth. (D)
questions.solution: 'to shun' will be used instead of 'for shun' because the fixed preposition 'to' is always used with the verb 'exhort.' The correct sentence will be: "exhorted people of the state to shun drugs and restore the health of Punjabi youth."

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . Sri Lanka’s ninth presidential election, (A)/ scheduled for September 21, has attracted a record 39 candidates, (B)/ signalling a return to “business as usual” (C)/ despite of the severe economic crisis of 2022. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Sri Lanka’s ninth presidential election, (A)/ scheduled for September 21, has attracted a record 39 candidates, (B)/ signalling a return to “business as usual” (C)/ despite of the severe economic crisis of 2022. (D)
questions.solution: 'despite' will be used instead of 'despite of' because 'despite' does not require the preposition 'of.' It is sufficient on its own and means 'in spite of.' The correct sentence will be: "despite the severe economic crisis of 2022."

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph . P . Browsing through the pages, I could not help smiling as Q . I recalled grandma and mother coming up with in our local language to match each situation that I encountered in my younger days R . Clearing an overflowing cupboard, I came across an old school notebook filled with English S . sayings meant to be written on the classroom blackboard at school each day
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

P. Browsing through the pages, I could not help smiling as

Q. I recalled grandma and mother coming up with in our local language to match each situation that I encountered in my younger days

R. Clearing an overflowing cupboard, I came across an old school notebook filled with English

S. sayings meant to be written on the classroom blackboard at school each day
questions.solution: R: R starts with an adverbial phrase ("Clearing an overflowing cupboard") that sets the context. The main clause follows, introducing the subject (notebook).
